image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a sliced meatloaf on a white plate. The foreground shows the cut cross-section of the loaf, revealing a dense, moist interior with visible flecks of red (likely tomato or pepper) and green herbs. The exterior crust is browned and appears to have a glossy, reddish glaze. In the blurred background, there are side dishes including orange carrots and yellow potatoes.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The internal texture of the meatloaf appears slightly 'waxy' or overly smooth in certain areas, lacking the distinct granular separation of individual ground meat strands often seen in high-resolution real photos. It has a slight 'smudged' look common in AI generations.

The background carrots and potatoes exhibit a 'painterly' blur rather than optical bokeh. The shapes merge into each other without clear boundaries, suggesting generative smoothing rather than lens depth-of-field.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary between the crust and the plate/background in the top left is slightly indistinct, with the crust texture bleeding into the background elements.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interior texture of the meatloaf. Real ground meat usually has distinct fibers and fat renderings; AI often smears this into a homogeneous paste. Also, evaluate if the background blur looks like natural lens bokeh or generative 'melting'.
